title: Error-Controlled Decision Policies for Medical Foundation Models.
publicationName: medRxiv : the preprint server for health sciences
journalName: medRxiv : the preprint server for health sciences
snippet: To use foundation models in medicine, clinicians need decision policies that act on model predictions within an explicit error budget, such as a limit on the rate of false positive calls.
